title: Insurance Premiums in a Summit Reserve's Property Tax Refund Need
content:
In the review of a returned property tax refund on a Summit Tax and Insurance Reserve under Set-Aside Accounts, the insurance part of the reserve's need turns on how many hazard insurance payments the reserve itself made in the twelve months before the handling date: hazard insurance payments from the reserve's ledger dated no later than the handling date and fewer than twelve whole calendar months before it.

## Rule

- **Exactly one hazard payment — renewal dates.** The insurance part is counted on renewal dates. The annual hazard premium on file counts in full only when the next hazard renewal — one year after the latest due date among the reserve's paid hazard insurance bills — is fewer whole months from the handling date than the horizon months. The annual flood premium on file counts in full only when the next flood renewal — one year after the latest due date among the reserve's paid flood insurance bills — is fewer whole months away than the horizon months. A premium that does not meet its test, or that has no paid bill of its kind on file, adds nothing; the two that meet it are added together.
- **Two or more hazard payments — quarter blocks.** The insurance part is counted in quarter blocks: each started quarter of the horizon carries a quarter of the annual hazard and flood premiums on file. The insurance part is the number of started quarters (the horizon months divided by three, any fraction counting as a whole block) times one quarter of the sum of the two annual premiums.
- Where the reserve made no hazard insurance payment in those twelve months, this rule does not apply.

Months to a renewal are whole calendar months from the handling date to the renewal date; a renewal date already past gives a count below zero.

## Hypothetical illustrations (horizon 6 months; hazard 1,200.00 and flood 600.00 on file)

| Hazard payments in 12 months | Renewal facts | Insurance part |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Hazard renews in 4 whole months; flood in 8 | 1,200.00 (hazard only) |
| 1 | Both renew in 2 whole months | 1,800.00 |
| 1 | Hazard renews in 6 whole months, no paid flood bill | nothing |
| 2 | — | 2 started quarters times 450.00, 900.00 |
| 3 | horizon 7 months instead | 3 started quarters times 450.00, 1,350.00 |
